headline: Legal charges hide a beat; Core FFO guidance raised
summary_short: Essex reported Q2 FY2026 net income per diluted share of $0.97, down 71.8% y/y on legal settlement charges and a lapped real-estate gain, while Core FFO per diluted share rose 1.2% y/y to $4.08, beating guidance.
summary_long: Net income per diluted share fell 71.8% y/y to $0.97 as Q2 2025 included a real-estate gain and Q2 2026 carried $55.8M of legal settlement charges, both excluded from Core FFO. Core FFO per diluted share rose 1.2% y/y to $4.08, beating guidance midpoint by $0.10 on stronger same-property and non-same-property NOI. Same-property revenue and NOI grew 2.7% and 2.6% y/y, led by Northern California (+4.4%); Seattle Metro NOI fell on higher operating expenses. Essex repurchased $11.7M of stock and raised full-year Core FFO guidance to $16.03-$16.25 (from $15.69-$16.19), while cutting net income guidance on the settlement charges. Cash was $58.3M; long-term debt fell 6.6% q/q to $6.39B.
